sourcedSteps.title: Create Your SoSoValue Account
sourcedSteps.body: Visit SoSoValue and sign up with email or a wallet. The same account works across the web platform and the iOS and Android apps.

sourcedSteps.title: Earn EXP Through Platform Tasks
sourcedSteps.body: Open the EXP page from the badge in the top-right of the SoSoValue interface and complete Starter Pack and daily tasks. These include exploring dashboards, learning about SSI indexes, the daily check-in, and inviting friends with your referral link. This Season 3 path is free and does not require any capital.

sourcedSteps.title: Connect a Wallet and Add ValueChain
sourcedSteps.body: Connect MetaMask or another Web3 wallet, then add the ValueChain network so you can hold SSI tokens and trade on SoDEX. Fund the wallet with USDC, which you can buy on Binance if you need it, or bridge directly using the widget below. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab

sourcedSteps.title: Buy SSI Index Tokens
sourcedSteps.body: Open the SSI page and buy one of the index products based on the sector exposure you want: MAG7.ssi: a large-cap basket index DEFI.ssi: a DeFi sector index MEME.ssi: a meme sector index USSI: a USD-denominated index

sourcedSteps.title: Stake Your SSI Tokens
sourcedSteps.body: Go to the Stake to Earn tab and stake your index tokens. Holding earns a 3x point multiplier, but staking raises it to 15x, so staked positions earn far more Loyalty Points. There is a 14-day cooldown before you can withdraw staked tokens.

sourcedSteps.title: Deposit into the SoDEX Vault
sourcedSteps.body: Deposit sMAG7.ssi or MAG7.ssi into the SoDEX Vault to earn passive SoPoints on top of your staking rewards, adding the extra APR layer with no extra trading.

sourcedSteps.title: Trade on SoDEX to Earn SoPoints
sourcedSteps.body: Head to SoDEX and trade spot or perpetual pairs. Trading volume is the most effective way to earn SoPoints, and the dynamic weighting model rewards steady, organic activity over one-time spikes.

sourcedSteps.title: Stake SOSO and Invite Friends
sourcedSteps.body: Stake SOSO in the Reward tab to boost your Loyalty Points. Once you pass 1,000 USDC in SoDEX volume, you can unlock a referral code that pays 10% fee rebates and 25% of your invitees’ points with no cap.

sourcedSteps.title: Claim Your SOSO Rewards
sourcedSteps.body: Rewards are distributed by smart contract after each epoch ends. Return to the Reward page when the claim window opens, connect your wallet, and claim your SOSO within the 90-day window.
